methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched and verified live on 2026-06-19: booqable.com/pricing (all four tiers and add-ons confirmed exact), twicecommerce.com/pricing (all tiers, 25% annual discount, $1-first-month promo, and per-tier payment fees confirmed; rentle.io/pricing 301-redirects here — verified), rentman.io/pricing (EUR-native modular pricing confirmed; USD toggle requires JS, so monthlyUsd left null), current-rms.com/pricing (per-seat $79/$49 confirmed; multi-currency), and pro.goodshuffle.com/pricing + /pricing-calculator/ (live, quote-only, NO published dollar amounts — monthlyUsd null). EZRentOut's official page (ezo.io/ezrentout/pricing/) renders as a truncated SPA; its Essential $59 / Growth $399 / Premium $499 monthly tiers are corroborated independently by BOTH GetApp and Capterra, so prices stand, but seat counts are vendor-FAQ-only and not corroborated by those listings. Goodshuffle and EZRentOut Enterprise have no published price -> null (a null beats a guess). Compliance flags left null unless the vendor explicitly attests (Rentman and Current RMS explicitly state GDPR). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: Booqable
vendors.provenance: Fetched booqable.com/pricing and booqable.com/integrations on 2026-06-19 and verified live. Monthly-billing rates: Start $35, Grow $87, Scale $187, Custom from $349. Annual-billing equivalents: $29/$69/$149. Add-on prices confirmed exact on the pricing page.

plans.name: Start
plans.notes: 1 user included. Unlimited inventory and orders, with feature caps (limited product history rows, custom email templates, custom fields, blackout periods). $29/mo when billed annually (vendor advertises ~20% off).

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Up to 6 users (1 base + 5 extra). Unlimited inventory, orders, custom email templates, custom fields, blackout periods. Includes onboarding. $69/mo when billed annually.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Up to 11 users (1 base + 10 extra). All limits unlimited; multi-location and advanced features. Includes onboarding. $149/mo when billed annually.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Starting at $349/mo. 20+ extra users and advanced security options. Contact sales for exact quote.

limits: Start: 1 user, limited product history rows, limited custom email templates and custom fields
Add-ons (per month, annual price): +$9/$12 per user mobile POS, +$9/$12 per user barcode scanning, +$9 deliveries, +$29/$37 per location multi-location, +$19/$24 rental website builder
keyFeatures: Unlimited inventory and orders on all plans
Rental website builder add-on
Online booking with real-time availability
Mobile POS and barcode scanning add-ons
enrichment.provenance: Pricing fetched and verified live at booqable.com/pricing; integrations from booqable.com/integrations. No forever-free plan; 14-day trial. Booqable does not claim SOC 2/HIPAA on its own security page, so compliance left null.

vendors.name: EZRentOut
vendors.provenance: Official page ezo.io/ezrentout/pricing/ renders as a truncated SPA (could not be read in plain text — a real extraction limitation). Plan prices Essential $59 / Growth $399 / Premium $499 per month are corroborated independently by BOTH GetApp and Capterra. Enterprise is custom (null). Seat counts (2/4/6) are from the vendor FAQ and are NOT corroborated by the aggregator listings, so they are flagged as unverified in plan notes.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: $59/mo (corroborated on GetApp and Capterra). Core rental management, online bookings, availability calendar, mobile app, 24/7 email support. Seat count (~2 users) per vendor FAQ; not corroborated on aggregator listings.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $399/mo (corroborated on GetApp and Capterra). Adds advanced calendar scheduling, reporting, webstore, additional integrations. Seat count (~4 users) per vendor FAQ; not corroborated on aggregator listings.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $499/mo (corroborated on GetApp and Capterra). Full suite: maintenance tracking, sub-rentals, accounting integrations, advanced workflows. Seat count (~6 users) per vendor FAQ; not corroborated on aggregator listings.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing (no published amount). Adds GPS support, multi-site support, tailored feature set. Contact sales.

limits: Essential / Growth / Premium seat counts per vendor FAQ (~2 / ~4 / ~6 users) — not corroborated on aggregator listings
keyFeatures: Equipment availability calendar
Online rental webstore (Growth+)
Maintenance and sub-rental tracking (Premium+)
GPS tracking (Enterprise)
enrichment.provenance: Official page truncated (SPA). Prices $59/$399/$499 corroborated on GetApp AND Capterra. No forever-free plan (Capterra: 'No free version'); 7-day trial per official sign-up page (some promo materials say 15 days). Compliance left null — no explicit vendor attestation.

vendors.name: Twice Commerce (formerly Rentle)
vendors.provenance: Fetched and verified live at www.twicecommerce.com/pricing on 2026-06-19. rentle.io/pricing returns HTTP 301 to twicecommerce.com/pricing — verified. Monthly rates are month-to-month; annual rates reflect a 25% discount as published.

plans.name: Discover
plans.notes: Up to 1,000 inventory items, 2 users, 1 store location, 2 pick-up points. $29/mo billed annually. $1 first-month promo available. Payment fee 3.4%+$0.45 (TWICE Payments) or 2.0% (Stripe).

plans.name: Build
plans.notes: Up to 5,000 inventory items, 5 users, 1 store location, 5 pick-up points. $69/mo billed annually. $1 first-month promo available. Payment fee 2.4%+$0.35 (TWICE Payments) or 1.0% (Stripe).

plans.name: Advance
plans.notes: Up to 30,000 inventory items, 10 users, 5 store locations, 10 pick-up points. $359/mo billed annually. Payment fee 1.4%+$0.25 (TWICE Payments) or 0.5% (Stripe).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $2,000/mo, billed annually only. 150,000+ inventory items, 50+ users, 10+ locations, 25+ pick-up points. Custom above stated minimum; payment fees based on volume.

keyFeatures: PCI DSS Level 1 certified
Supports rentals and resale (circular commerce)
Per-transaction payment fees vary by plan tier
Integrated online storefront with Wix partnership
enrichment.provenance: Fetched and verified live at www.twicecommerce.com/pricing. rentle.io/pricing 301-redirects to twicecommerce.com/pricing (verified), confirming same product after the Rentle->Twice Commerce rebrand. 3-day trial, no forever-free plan. Compliance flags left null (no explicit HIPAA/SOC2/GDPR attestation on pricing page).

vendors.name: Rentman
vendors.provenance: Fetched and verified live at rentman.io/pricing on 2026-06-19. Pricing is EUR-native; a USD toggle exists but requires JavaScript, so monthlyUsd is left null and EUR amounts are stated in notes. €39/mo platform base fee plus per-power-user modules confirmed.

plans.name: Platform (base fee)
plans.notes: €39/month base platform fee required for all accounts. Includes CRM, task management, team collaboration, dashboards, calendars, file sharing. Power Users billed separately; Basic Users (warehouse/field staff) are free. USD not shown (requires JS toggle).

plans.name: Equipment Scheduling Standard
plans.notes: €14/month per Power User. Availability tracking, shortage warnings, inventory bundles, packing lists, project planning. Added on top of the €39 platform fee.

plans.name: Equipment Scheduling Pro
plans.notes: €19/month per Power User. Full inventory scheduling features. Added on top of the platform fee.

plans.name: Crew Scheduling Essential
plans.notes: €14/month per Power User. Crew scheduling, email communication, crew app, transport scheduling. Added on top of the platform fee. (A Crew Scheduling Standard tier at €19/mo also exists between Essential and Pro.)

plans.name: Crew Scheduling Pro
plans.notes: €24/month per Power User. Full crew scheduling, labor scheduling, cost management. Added on top of the platform fee.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contact sales for Enterprise inventory and crew scheduling tiers.

limits: Pricing in EUR only (USD toggle requires JavaScript)
Power Users billed per seat; Basic Users always free
keyFeatures: Modular add-on pricing for inventory and crew scheduling separately
Free Basic Users for warehouse/field staff
Purpose-built for AV, event production, and crew management
30-day free trial, no credit card required
